question.text: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

exchange.sent: For a Semiconductor use case involving RFIC validation, where would Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fit in the test workflow?

answer.answer:
### Short answer
The passages do not explicitly describe a “Semiconductor RFIC validation” workflow, but they support placing Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in the RF test execution and measurement/analysis part of a broader implementation → test → debug → validation workflow, especially under RF / parametric / characterization testing and lab equipment integration [1][3][75].
### Where they fit in the workflow
| Workflow stage | Where Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fits | Supported role |
|---|---|---|
| Test setup / toolchain integration | They are lab equipment interfaces that can be integrated into repos, CI/CD, test frameworks, and log / analysis pipelines as part of an end-to-end test workflow [3]. | Instrument integration layer [3]. |
| RF / parametric / characterization test execution | R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW are mapped to the RF / parametric / characterization layer in the 5G device testing value chain [75]. | Core RF stimulus and measurement instruments [75]. |
| Receiver-side validation pattern | R&S SMW200A generates NR uplink wanted signals and can generate NR or CW interferers; signal and spectrum analyzers such as R&S FSW / FSVA3000 are used for receiver spurious emissions [38]. | Signal Generator provides stimulus / interferers; Signal Analyzer measures emissions [38]. |
| Transmitter-side validation pattern | R&S FSW spectrum analyzer performs measurements in the Tx test setup, while R&S SMW200A can be used as an interferer for transmitter intermodulation testing [34]. | Signal Analyzer measures DUT output; Signal Generator injects interferer conditions [34]. |
| Debug / analysis / validation closure | The broader virtual tester concept spans implementation → test → debug → validation, and validated results mean outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket [1][76]. | Analyzer outputs and measurement results feed debug and validation decisions [1][76]. |
### 【推論】
【推論】For an RFIC validation use case, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer would most defensibly be positioned as the RF stimulus-and-measurement layer inside test execution, with their results feeding debug and validation, because the knowledge base maps SMW200A / FSW to RF / parametric / characterization and defines the broader workflow as implementation → test → debug → validation [1][75].

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 與 point tools 的區分
問卷第 3b 題要求客戶說明他們是在尋找 point tools，或 broader [[Virtual tester]]：

- point tools examples：better scripting、log analysis。
- broader [[Virtual tester]]：spans implementation → test → debug → validation。

這個區分表示 [[Virtual tester]] 的範圍比單一 scripting assistant 或 log analyzer 更寬，但來源未提供具體產品功能矩陣。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 主要 RF performance（Version 31.00，May 2026）
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]：

- Frequency range：依 RF path frequency option，RF path A 最高 `100 kHz to 67 GHz`；RF path B 最高 `100 kHz to 44 GHz`。
- Overrange：`67 GHz to 72 GHz`。
- Resolution of setting：`0.001 Hz`。
- Resolution of synthesis：`0.053 nHz nominal`，條件 `f = 1 GHz`。
- Frequency setting time：依 frequency option 為 `< 1.2 ms` 至 `< 1.8 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` 為 `< 4.0 ms`。條件包含 GUI update stopped、I/Q optimization mode fast、after IEC/IEEE bus delimiter、HUMS off。
- Frequency setting time in list mode：依 frequency option為 `< 0.8 ms` 至 `< 1.4 ms`；with `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721`、run mode live 為 `< 4.0 ms`。
- Level setting range：`100 kHz ≤ f < 1 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +8 dBm`；`1 MHz ≤ f < 3 MHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +13 dBm`；`3 MHz ≤ f ≤ 67 GHz` 為 `–145 dBm to +30 dBm`。
- Standard performance SSB phase noise 條件：CW，carrier offset `20 kHz`，measurement bandwidth `1 Hz`，level `10 dBm` 或 maximum specified output power 兩者較低者；`f = 1 GHz` 為 `< –134 dBc`，typ. `–140 dBc`。
- `R&S®SMW-B711/-B721` ultra low phase noise 在 `1 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–144 dBc`，typ. `–150 dBc`；在 `67 GHz`、`10 kHz offset` 下為 `–105 dBc`，typ. `–111 dBc`。
- Pulse modulation 需 `R&S®SMW-K22`；一般 on/off ratio `> 80 dB`，部分高頻條件例外為 `> 65 dB`。
- Pulse rise/fall time（10 % / 90 % of RF amplitude）：低頻 frequency options fast transition `< 10 ns`；多數 20 GHz 以上 options fast transition `< 15 ns`；smoothed transition 多數條件 `< 200 ns`。
- Internal baseband I/Q、wideband baseband (`R&S®SMW-B13XT`)、I/Q wideband on：`f > 2.5 GHz` 時 `±1 GHz`；RF modulation bandwidth 可達 `2 GHz`。

- 第三階段 commercialization readiness 包含供應鏈最終化、[[MediaTek]] 5G NTN roadmap、[[工研院]] ITRI gNB development、SLA negotiation 與 2026+ commercial launch roadmap。

- OEM ecosystem 區列出 [[Intellian]]、[[Hughes]]、[[Kymeta]]、[[Sharp]]，並延伸列出 [[Gilat]] / [[Gilat ESR-2030Ku]]、[[ThinKom]] / [[ThinKom Ka2517]]、[[Satcom Direct]] / [[Plane Simple]]、[[PALS]] / [[PPA-SOTM]]、[[SatixFy]] / [[SatixFy ESMA]]、[[Intelsat]] / [[Intelsat ESA]]、[[Requtech]] / [[RESA]]、[[Asmote]]。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › 涵蓋測項
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021），[[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 測項如下：

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |
| 6.3.2 | RE power control dynamic range | RE power 與 average RE power 差值；來源說由 EVM test 提供足夠 coverage。 |
| 6.3.3 | Total power dynamic range | OFDM symbol maximum transmit power 與 minimum transmit power 差值。 |
| 6.3.4 | NB-IoT RB power dynamic range | NB-IoT power boosting；與 OBUE / SEM 一起測試。 |
| 6.4 | Transmit ON/OFF power | TDD operation 的 transmitter OFF period mean power。 |
| 6.5.2 | Frequency error | actual NR BS transmit frequency 與 assigned frequency 的差值。 |
| 6.5.3 | Modulation quality | 以 EVM 表示 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。 |
| 6.5.4 | Time alignment error（TAE） | 多個 NR signals 之間最大 timing difference。 |
| 6.6.2 | Occupied bandwidth（OBW） | 99% power bandwidth；測得 OBW 應小於 nominal bandwidth。 |
| 6.6.3 | Adjacent channel leakage power ratio（ACLR） | assigned channel power 與 adjacent channel power 的 filtered mean power ratio。 |
| 6.6.4 | Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM） | Operating band unwanted emissions / spectrum emission mask。 |
| 6.6.5 | Transmitter spurious emissions | 9 kHz 至 12.75 GHz 及部分 band 5th harmonic 上限的 spurious emission 測試。 |
| 6.7 | Transmitter intermodulation | 需額外 interferer，評估 transmitter 抑制 intermodulation products 的能力。 |

5G NR conducted base station receiver tests › Chapter 7 test cases
依 [[GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests]]（12.2020），GFM314 覆蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests：

| Test case | 名稱 | 來源摘要 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | Reference Sensitivity Level | 測量 receiver 在 reference sensitivity power level `PREFSENS` 下是否滿足 reference measurement channel throughput requirement。 |
| 7.3 | Dynamic Range | 測量 receiver 在 received channel bandwidth 內存在 [[AWGN]] interferer 時接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.1 | Adjacent Channel Selectivity（ACS） | 測量 receiver 在相鄰通道 5G NR interferer 存在時接收 assigned channel wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.2a | In-band Blocking: General | 以 NR interferer center frequency 1 MHz step size 掃描，測量 in-band blocking。 |
| 7.4.2b | In-band Blocking: Narrow-band blocking | 類似 ACS，但 interfering signal 只包含 1 resource block。 |
| 7.5 | Out-of-band Blocking | 以 CW interferer 進行 out-of-band blocking 掃頻測試。 |
| 7.6 | Receiver Spurious Emissions | 測量 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。 |
| 7.7 | Receiver Intermodulation | 測量 two interfering signals（CW + QPSK NR signal）造成 intermodulation effect 時 receiver 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.8 | In-channel selectivity | 測量較高 PSD interferer 存在下，receiver 在 assigned RB locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not explicitly describe a “Semiconductor RFIC validation” workflow, but they support placing Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in the RF test execution and measurement/analysis part of a broader implementation → test → debug → validation workflow, especially under RF / parametric / characterization testing and lab equipment integration [1][3][75].
### Where they fit in the workflow
| Workflow stage | Where Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fits | Supported role |
|---|---|---|
| Test setup / toolchain integration | They are lab equipment interfaces that can be integrated into repos, CI/CD, test frameworks, and log / analysis pipelines as part of an end-to-end test workflow [3]. | Instrument integration layer [3]. |
| RF / parametric / characterization test execution | R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW are mapped to the RF / parametric / characterization layer in the 5G device testing value chain [75]. | Core RF stimulus and measurement instruments [75]. |
| Receiver-side validation pattern | R&S SMW200A generates NR uplink wanted signals and can generate NR or CW interferers; signal and spectrum analyzers such as R&S FSW / FSVA3000 are used for receiver spurious emissions [38]. | Signal Generator provides stimulus / interferers; Signal Analyzer measures emissions [38]. |
| Transmitter-side validation pattern | R&S FSW spectrum analyzer performs measurements in the Tx test setup, while R&S SMW200A can be used as an interferer for transmitter intermodulation testing [34]. | Signal Analyzer measures DUT output; Signal Generator injects interferer conditions [34]. |
| Debug / analysis / validation closure | The broader virtual tester concept spans implementation → test → debug → validation, and validated results mean outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket [1][76]. | Analyzer outputs and measurement results feed debug and validation decisions [1][76]. |
### 【推論】
【推論】For an RFIC validation use case, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer would most defensibly be positioned as the RF stimulus-and-measurement layer inside test execution, with their results feeding debug and validation, because the knowledge base maps SMW200A / FSW to RF / parametric / characterization and defines the broader workflow as implementation → test → debug → validation [1][75].

- [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_ScriptAssist]] 與 [[AIW_on_prem_prerequisites_TechAssist]] 定義部署前 must-have items；[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 則用問題蒐集客戶工作流、政策、工具與導入風險。
- 本文件補充 [[R&S AI Workplace Solutions]] 的定位：它不只討論 on-prem prerequisites，也涉及 virtual testing、AI-assisted / agentic test workflows、toolchain integration 與 adoption planning。
- 本文件的 [[Orchestration layer]] 定義與既有 [[Coding Agent Harness]] 不同：前者是 shared rules / instructions / skills coordination layer，後者在 prerequisites 中是 coding agent 工具 / harness 選項。兩者可互連，但不可直接合併為同一概念。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows
[[AI-assisted agentic test workflows]] 是 [[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 用來描述 AI 協助測試建立、結果分析與工具整合的一組客戶需求場景，重點在 agentic workflow 如何連到既有 engineering environment；[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 另提供一個 [[R&S CMX500]] scripting / automation solution-level 例子。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows › 工作流範圍
問卷把相關工作流拆成多個面向：

- 從 new test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程。
- scripting、environment setup、debugging failures、documentation 等耗時點。
- test failure 或 ambiguous log 的 investigation ownership 與耗時。
- AI coding assistants、IDE agents、CI bots、internal automation 的既有使用狀況。
- 既有 test stack：instruments、software、CI、issue trackers。
- [[Orchestration layer]] 需 plug in 的位置。
- point tools 與 broader [[Virtual tester]] 的需求差異。

AI-assisted agentic test workflows › 成功指標
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 列出可衡量 AI-assisted test workflow 價值的 metrics：

- time to first test；
- mean time to debug；
- regression coverage；
- reuse of tests；
- fewer expert escalations；
- faster scripting；
- fewer debug cycles；
- better reuse of tests；
- less expert dependency。

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]] 的 PR 語言與這些 metrics 有方向性對應，例如 significantly less time and effort、reducing the risk of errors 與 speeding up time-to-market；但來源未提供量化 benchmark 或驗證方法。

5G device testing value chain
[[5G device testing value chain]] 是 [[Rethink 5G Testing solution overview 5G RedCap NTN FWA]] 中整理的 5G device ecosystem 測試分工：從 chip vendor、device manufacturer、test house 到 network operator，依 Lab、R&D、Production、Operations 與 Use cases 串接 RF、signaling、application、OTA、pre-conformance、conformance、carrier acceptance 與 service / repair 測試。

5G device testing value chain › 使用限制
- 本頁不是 3GPP conformance specification，也不是 R&S formal product configuration guide。
- 來源中的工具 mapping 是 solution overview / sales enablement 層級；不得替代 datasheet、test case list、option dependency 或 calibration procedure。
- 來源未標示正式日期；市場數字與 operator requirements 需按其各自來源與日期重新驗證。

5G device testing value chain › Validation and Conformance 目標
來源指出 validation and conformance 測試目標包含：

- Chipset L1–L4 test plan and verification。
- Investigate and debug modem stack。
- Validate and optimize end to end performance of IMS / SIP / TCP/IP。
- Investigate and debug app stack。
- Plan、develop、execute 3GPP / carrier device tests。
- Radiated and conducted testing。

測試目的包含：

- Final product according to [[3GPP]] specs and KPIs 的 conformance。
- Final product for different carriers 的 conformance。
- New product introduction test framework 與 pilot production tests。
- 確認 HW / SW 如設計般運作。
- Cellular transceiver systems optimization。
- Meet 3GPP specifications or custom design criteria。
- Assure robustness / reliability and performance on L1–L3。
- Optimize each stack for highest throughput and defined KPIs。
- Ensure robustness / reliability and performance on IMS、TCP/IP stack and app protocols。

Validated results › 限制與未決事項
- 來源未定義 validated results 的技術驗證流程、審核人員、品質門檻或合規要求。
- 來源未說明哪些 decisions must stay with engineers vs can be automated；問卷要求客戶自行回答。
- 來源未提供具體 test framework、ticket system 或 reporting system integration。

Validated results › 與 Virtual tester 的關係
[[Virtual tester]] 被定義為跨 implementation → test → debug → validation 的 agentic workflow。[[Validated results]] 可視為該 workflow 的目標結果之一，但來源未提供 validation criteria、test coverage threshold 或品質標準。

Validated results › 問卷中的角色
問卷第 1a 題以 `new test idea to running, validated results` 描述客戶當前 workflow，並追問耗時環節，例如：

- scripting；
- environment setup；
- debugging failures；
- documentation。

問卷第 4 段則要求客戶定義 success criteria，例如 time to first test、mean time to debug、regression coverage、reuse of tests、fewer expert escalations，以及 minimal human intervention 的邊界。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › R&S solution setup
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021）：

- 完整 Tx test setup 使用 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 執行量測。
- 6.7 transmitter intermodulation 使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 作為 interferer。
- 5G NR measurements 需 5G NR Downlink Measurements software option：R&S FSW-/FSV3-/FSV-/FPS-/VSE-K144。
- 6.7 interferer 可由 [[R&S SMW200A]] 或 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 搭配 -K144 5G NR software option 產生。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 也可用於示範目的，模擬 5G NR base station；來源明示 vector signal generator 不能模擬所有 base station functions。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › 涵蓋測項
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021），[[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 6 測項如下：

| Test case | 名稱 | 測試重點 |
|---|---|---|
| 6.2 | Base station output power | 驗證 maximum carrier output power 準確度。 |
| 6.3.2 | RE power control dynamic range | RE power 與 average RE power 差值；來源說由 EVM test 提供足夠 coverage。 |
| 6.3.3 | Total power dynamic range | OFDM symbol maximum transmit power 與 minimum transmit power 差值。 |
| 6.3.4 | NB-IoT RB power dynamic range | NB-IoT power boosting；與 OBUE / SEM 一起測試。 |
| 6.4 | Transmit ON/OFF power | TDD operation 的 transmitter OFF period mean power。 |
| 6.5.2 | Frequency error | actual NR BS transmit frequency 與 assigned frequency 的差值。 |
| 6.5.3 | Modulation quality | 以 EVM 表示 measured carrier signal 與 reference signal 的差異。 |
| 6.5.4 | Time alignment error（TAE） | 多個 NR signals 之間最大 timing difference。 |
| 6.6.2 | Occupied bandwidth（OBW） | 99% power bandwidth；測得 OBW 應小於 nominal bandwidth。 |
| 6.6.3 | Adjacent channel leakage power ratio（ACLR） | assigned channel power 與 adjacent channel power 的 filtered mean power ratio。 |
| 6.6.4 | Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM） | Operating band unwanted emissions / spectrum emission mask。 |
| 6.6.5 | Transmitter spurious emissions | 9 kHz 至 12.75 GHz 及部分 band 5th harmonic 上限的 spurious emission 測試。 |
| 6.7 | Transmitter intermodulation | 需額外 interferer，評估 transmitter 抑制 intermodulation products 的能力。 |

5G NR conducted base station receiver tests › Chapter 7 test cases
依 [[GFM314_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Rx_Tests]]（12.2020），GFM314 覆蓋下列 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] chapter 7 receiver tests：

| Test case | 名稱 | 來源摘要 |
|---|---|---|
| 7.2 | Reference Sensitivity Level | 測量 receiver 在 reference sensitivity power level `PREFSENS` 下是否滿足 reference measurement channel throughput requirement。 |
| 7.3 | Dynamic Range | 測量 receiver 在 received channel bandwidth 內存在 [[AWGN]] interferer 時接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.1 | Adjacent Channel Selectivity（ACS） | 測量 receiver 在相鄰通道 5G NR interferer 存在時接收 assigned channel wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.4.2a | In-band Blocking: General | 以 NR interferer center frequency 1 MHz step size 掃描，測量 in-band blocking。 |
| 7.4.2b | In-band Blocking: Narrow-band blocking | 類似 ACS，但 interfering signal 只包含 1 resource block。 |
| 7.5 | Out-of-band Blocking | 以 CW interferer 進行 out-of-band blocking 掃頻測試。 |
| 7.6 | Receiver Spurious Emissions | 測量 receiver 產生或放大的 emissions 出現在 BS receiver antenna connector 的功率。 |
| 7.7 | Receiver Intermodulation | 測量 two interfering signals（CW + QPSK NR signal）造成 intermodulation effect 時 receiver 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |
| 7.8 | In-channel selectivity | 測量較高 PSD interferer 存在下，receiver 在 assigned RB locations 接收 wanted signal 的能力。 |

answer.text:
### Short answer
The passages do not explicitly describe a “Semiconductor RFIC validation” workflow, but they support placing Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer in the RF test execution and measurement/analysis part of a broader implementation → test → debug → validation workflow, especially under RF / parametric / characterization testing and lab equipment integration [1][3][75].
### Where they fit in the workflow
| Workflow stage | Where Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer fits | Supported role |
|---|---|---|
| Test setup / toolchain integration | They are lab equipment interfaces that can be integrated into repos, CI/CD, test frameworks, and log / analysis pipelines as part of an end-to-end test workflow [3]. | Instrument integration layer [3]. |
| RF / parametric / characterization test execution | R&S SMW200A and R&S FSW are mapped to the RF / parametric / characterization layer in the 5G device testing value chain [75]. | Core RF stimulus and measurement instruments [75]. |
| Receiver-side validation pattern | R&S SMW200A generates NR uplink wanted signals and can generate NR or CW interferers; signal and spectrum analyzers such as R&S FSW / FSVA3000 are used for receiver spurious emissions [38]. | Signal Generator provides stimulus / interferers; Signal Analyzer measures emissions [38]. |
| Transmitter-side validation pattern | R&S FSW spectrum analyzer performs measurements in the Tx test setup, while R&S SMW200A can be used as an interferer for transmitter intermodulation testing [34]. | Signal Analyzer measures DUT output; Signal Generator injects interferer conditions [34]. |
| Debug / analysis / validation closure | The broader virtual tester concept spans implementation → test → debug → validation, and validated results mean outcomes trusted enough to report, ship against, or close a ticket [1][76]. | Analyzer outputs and measurement results feed debug and validation decisions [1][76]. |
### 【推論】
【推論】For an RFIC validation use case, Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer would most defensibly be positioned as the RF stimulus-and-measurement layer inside test execution, with their results feeding debug and validation, because the knowledge base maps SMW200A / FSW to RF / parametric / characterization and defines the broader workflow as implementation → test → debug → validation [1][75].

Virtual tester › 來源定義
[[AIW_Products_Customer_Questionnaire]] 的 short definitions 寫道：

> Virtual tester: an agentic workflow that spans implementation → test → debug → validation, not a single tool.

因此本庫把 [[Virtual tester]] 記為工作流 / solution concept，而非單一軟體工具或儀器。

Virtual tester › 可能涵蓋的流程
依問卷上下文，[[Virtual tester]] 相關需求可能涉及：

- test idea 到 running, [[Validated results]] 的流程理解；
- test script generation 或 refactoring；
- ambiguous logs / failure debugging；
- documentation lookup；
- end-to-end test execution；
- toolchain integration：repos、CI/CD、test frameworks、lab equipment interfaces、log / analysis pipelines；
- [[Orchestration layer]] 對 AI agents 的 rules、instructions、skills coordination。

以上是問卷問題範圍，不是已確認產品功能。

5G NR conducted base station transmitter tests › R&S solution setup
依 [[GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests]]（01.2021）：

- 完整 Tx test setup 使用 [[R&S FSW]] spectrum analyzer 執行量測。
- 6.7 transmitter intermodulation 使用 [[R&S SMW200A]] signal generator 作為 interferer。
- 5G NR measurements 需 5G NR Downlink Measurements software option：R&S FSW-/FSV3-/FSV-/FPS-/VSE-K144。
- 6.7 interferer 可由 [[R&S SMW200A]] 或 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 搭配 -K144 5G NR software option 產生。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S SMBV100B]] 也可用於示範目的，模擬 5G NR base station；來源明示 vector signal generator 不能模擬所有 base station functions。
